newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-PALMER RETURNS AT BAY HILL INVITATIONAL.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PALMER RETURNS AT BAY HILL INVITATIONAL.

text.p: Just nine weeks after undergoing surgery for prostate cancer, Arnold Palmer makes his return to competitive golf when the $1.5 million Bay Hill Classic begins on Thursday at the Palmer-owned Bay Hill Club.
The 67-year-old Palmer has been one of the most recognisable athletes in sports over the last four decades, winning four Masters, two British Opens and one U.S. Open in his legendary career.
He ranks fourth on the all-time PGA Tour victory list with 60 titles and also has won 10 Senior Tournaments.

With the return of Palmer, the focus shifts from Tiger Woods, who has won three times in 12 PGA Tour events. Woods played in this event in 1994 as an 18-year-old amateur, shooting 80 and 77 in the first two rounds.
The field, which includes 38 of the top 50 players in the current world rankings, includes defending champion Paul Goydos, who recorded his first and only PGA Tour victory last year.
The field also features Stuart Appleby of Australia, who captured his first career victory in last week's $1.5 million Honda Classic.
